'''KyLessian Fruit Distillate''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] liquor. It was considered a delicacy in the cantinas of the Outer Rim. The fruit used was from the [[Wulfruit tree]] which was native to the planet [[KyLessia]].
